::: {.hero}
# Agentic AI Workshop for Bioconductor and R

::: {.hero-meta}
[July 31, 2026]{} [·]{.dot} [8:00 AM – 5:00 PM]{} [·]{.dot} [Maxwell Dworkin, Harvard University, Cambridge, MA]{}
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Registration is now CLOSED.
:::

A one-day, hands-on workshop on agentic AI for the Bioconductor and R
community — what coding agents are, how to use them effectively, and how
they can accelerate package development and developer workflows.

The morning is didactic: an introduction to agents, followed by skills,
MCP, and effective use of agents and sub-agents. The afternoon is
hands-on: agents building real projects, a focus group on Bioconductor
and developer activities, and small-group deep dives on projects you
care about.

::: {.callout-important}
## Before you arrive

Sign up for a coding agent for your own use **before the workshop** —
you'll need it for the afternoon sessions. See
[Before You Arrive](setup.qmd) for options and details.
:::
